confirm_disable_entity.description:
The {integration_name} in progress binary sensor `{entity_id}` is deprecated.

Migrate your configuration to use the corresponding `{assist_satellite_domain}` entity and then click SUBMIT to disable the in progress binary sensor and fix this issue.

assist_in_progress_deprecated.title: {integration_name} in progress binary sensors are deprecated

confirm.description:
Assist has been saving the audio of every voice command for more than 7 days, because `debug_recording_dir` is set in your configuration. {count} recordings ({size} MB) are kept in `{path}`.

To stop recording, remove `debug_recording_dir` from your configuration and restart Home Assistant. Select **Submit** to delete the recordings now.
confirm.title: [%key:component::assist_pipeline::issues::debug_recording_still_enabled::title%]

debug_recording_still_enabled.title: Voice debug recording is still turned on

abort.delete_failed: The debug recordings could not be deleted. Check the log for details and delete them manually.

confirm.description:
Debug recording for Assist is turned off, but {count} recordings ({size} MB) it saved earlier are still kept in `{path}`.

Select **Submit** to delete them.
confirm.title: [%key:component::assist_pipeline::issues::debug_recordings_left_over::title%]

debug_recordings_left_over.title: Voice debug recordings were left behind
